markets.question: Traffic through the Bab el-Mandeb Strait? (11/9 - 11/15) — Above 170
markets.rules: If the number of transit calls through the Bab el-Mandeb Strait as reported by the IMF PortWatch is above 170 from Nov 9, 2026 to Nov 15, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes. The total is calculated by summing daily counts from Nov 9, 2026 to Nov 15, 2026. The market will resolve no earlier than Tuesday at 9 AM following the end of the period, once complete data is available.

markets.question: Los Angeles R vs Arizona — Los Angeles R
markets.rules:
If Los Angeles R wins the Los Angeles R vs Arizona Pro Football game originally scheduled for Nov 15, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes. The following market refers to the team who wins the Los Angeles R vs Arizona Pro Football game originally scheduled for Nov 15, 2026. If the game ends in a tie, the market will resolve to $0.50 for each team. If the game is postponed but begins within 48 hours from its originally scheduled start time, the market will remain open and resolve based on the official final result. If the game is not started within 48 hours, the market will resolve to a fair price.

markets.question: Core CPI YoY in November — Above 2.8%
markets.rules: If the Consumer Price Index (CPI) for All Urban Consumers: All Items less Food and Energy increases by more than 2.8% in the twelve months ending November 2026 (as represented by the one-decimal place value reported by the Bureau of Labor Statistics), then the market resolves to Yes. In the case of a delay in data caused by a federal government shutdown impacting the reliability of the Source Agency, the market’s latest Expiration Date will be extended to the sooner of the release of the Underlying or six months after the end of the government shutdown.

markets.question: Ebenezer · Rotten Tomatoes score — Above 37
markets.rules:
If Ebenezer has a Tomatometer score of above 37 on Nov 16, 2026 at 10:00 AM ET, then the market resolves to Yes. The "Fresh!" and "Certified Fresh!" subtitles are meant for illustrative purposes only. The Tomatometer score must be above the strike value to resolve as YES (for example, a score of 75 would resolve "Above 75" as No.) The market will be determined the Monday after wide release at 10:00 AM ET.

This market and these products have not been endorsed by Rotten Tomatoes. Any references to Rotten Tomatoes or any associated marks are descriptive only and do not indicate an endorsement of this product or any affiliation between Rotten Tomatoes and Kalshi.

markets.question: What companies will Trump say in November? — Dell
markets.rules:
If Dell, or a plural or possessive form of Dell, is stated by Donald Trump before Dec 1, 2026 at 12:00am ET, then the market resolves to Yes. Payout criteria
The word or phrase must be stated by President Donald Trump in public statements, direct quotes published by Source Agencies, or written public statements on his personal social media accounts (Twitter/Truth Social).
The exact phrase/word, or a plural or possessive form of the phrase/word, must be used.
For phrases with slashes like "Doge/Dogecoin," either word satisfies the criterion.

Doesn't count for payout
 Official acts like Executive Orders or bills signed do not count. 
 Grammatical/tense inflections.

markets.question: Will Ethereum reach $2,400 in November?
markets.rules:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if any Binance 1 minute candle for ETH/USDT from the creation of this market through 11:59 PM ET on the last day of the month specified in the title has a final High price equal to or greater than the price specified in the title. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No". Price action before this market's creation will not be considered.

The resolution source for this market is Binance, specifically the ETH/USDT High prices available at https://www.binance.com/en/trade/ETH_USDT, with the chart settings on "1m" for one-minute candles selected on the top bar.

Please note that the outcome of this market depends solely on the price data from the Binance ETH/USDT trading pair. Prices from other exchanges, different trading pairs, or spot markets will not be considered for the resolution of this market.

markets.question: Sprite Point of Sale Growth in November 2026 — Above 99
markets.rules:
If the Carbon Arc Sprite Point of Sale Growth (November 2026) for November 2026 is above 99 , then the market resolves to Yes. For purposes of this market, determination will resolve on finalized Carbon Arc values recorded at 11:59 p.m. ET on the 2nd calendar day after the end of the month covered by this market. For example, finalized Carbon Arc values for August will be recorded at 11:59 p.m. ET on September 2nd.

The index measures year-over-year change, where 100 means Sprite Point of Sale Growth was equal to the same month last year. Values above 100 indicate growth and values below 100 indicate decline: for example, 103 = 3% more spend than year prior, 97 = 3% decline from year prior. The index is measured by Carbon Arc's point-of-sale receipt panel using in-store and online purchases captured via receipt-scanning and rewards apps, matched to the same period of the prior year. The panel updates daily as new data arrives.

markets.question: Best AI this week — Claude
markets.rules: If Anthropic has the top-ranked LLM on Nov 16, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes. If two models are tied under Rank (UB), then the model with the highest Arena Score will win. markets.rules:

A qualifying meeting need not result in any agreement, joint statement, or further engagement.
